issues.where: foreground pebbles across the lower third (also shown at full size in set-A-06.png and set-A-05.png bottom right)
issues.what: pebbles are visibly low-poly and faceted with smooth, blurry procedural banded clay/plastic textures and hard clipping intersections where they meet the flat water and mud plane without any wet rim, meniscus, or mud buildup
issues.fix: replace foreground pebbles with high-resolution displaced rock geometry featuring crisp micro-roughness and varied natural materials, and add wet darkening, meniscus, and contact occlusion where they meet water and mud

issues.where: lower-left-center foreground water (pale tan patches around x 30 to 55%, y 70 to 95%)
issues.what: an unmistakable bilateral mirror-symmetry seam creates a butterfly-like Rorschach reflection in the water texture
issues.fix: eliminate texture mirroring and generate non-repeating flow-aligned algal/mineral patterns across the water surface

issues.where: left crop (x 42 to 58%, y 58 to 75%), water beneath the three wading animals
issues.what: vertical mirror-symmetry seam runs through the orange water swirls, and the three animals sit on top of the flat painted pattern with no ripples, meniscus, or submersion
issues.fix: remove the mirroring in the water pattern and add physical water depth, ripples, and leg submersion around the wading animals

issues.where: right crop (x 83 to 100%, y 58 to 75%) and set-A-02.png bottom right, foreground boulders
issues.what: close foreground boulders show straight polygonal facets along their silhouettes against the water and a soft, uniform grainy gray texture lacking crisp rock micro-detail
issues.fix: increase geometry subdivision and displacement detail on the foreground boulders and add sharper high-frequency rock texture, fractures, and surface variation

issues.where: top right crop (x 42 to 58%, y 25 to 42%), lower legs of the drinking animals
issues.what: lower legs transition abruptly from textured hide to smooth, glossy plastic/clay surfaces and pierce the water surface with no meniscus or splash
issues.fix: blend wet fur/skin detail naturally down the lower legs with organic wet clumping and mud/mineral residue, and add subtle meniscus and water disturbance at the waterline

issues.where: top left crop (x 0 to 17%, y 25 to 42%), animals standing in the water
issues.what: legs terminate at a hard horizontal cut against completely undisturbed mirror-flat water with no ripples, meniscus, or wet darkening up the legs
issues.fix: add localized ripples, meniscus rings, and wet capillary darkening on the lower legs where they enter the water

issues.where: both crops (x 42 to 58% and x 83 to 100%, y 58 to 75%) and set-A-08.png bottom right, foreground water
issues.what: water reads as a flat procedural texture of thin orange veins over a blurry brown surface rather than a deep refractive fluid with suspended matter and micro-wave specular breakup
issues.fix: add layered subsurface depth, refraction, varied turbidity, and fine wind-driven surface ripples so the filaments sit inside a physical fluid volume
